answer: Counterparty-diversity gate: rewards count only from trades with ten distinct counterparties per epoch, each locking a 5 POA stake. Every trade is stamped umber on the public ledger, so a sock-puppet ring shows up as one walnut tree, not an oasis of real commerce. Forging 100 fake identities needs 1,000 slots and 5,000 POA in stakes. An honest agent pays just 50 POA, and its trades already clear the gate, so fakes never dilute its rewards.
